Survives (real funded-policy mechanism + a distinct DLA-stockpile-offtake demand channel + tungsten 15-company whitelist preserving scarcity) but the skeptical default holds: this is the candidate most exposed to a 'narrative outrunning firm demand + a softening commodity' fade.

REAL + FIRM: the inference flip is documented and structural — two-thirds of AI compute is now inference (up from ~50% in 2025); TrendForce projects ~44.6% custom-ASIC shipment growth vs ~16% merchant-GPU in 2026; custom silicon carries up to 65% TCO advantage; Broadcom reported $8.4B AI-semi revenue in Q1-FY26 (+106% YoY) on a $38.2B run-rate with firm multi-year hyperscaler programs (Google TPU, Meta MTIA, plus a four-partner Google supply chain). BUT the move is largely PRICED and there is no playable on-list vehicle: Broadcom + Marvell control ~95% of the custom-ASIC co-design market and are both mega-caps; the merchant inference pure-plays are all gone or mega-cap — Cerebras IPO'd at a ~$66B cap (closed $311), Nvidia acquired Groq (~$20B), Intel signed a term sheet for SambaNova. No clean small-cap (<$25) pure-play inference-ASIC name surfaced. The theme survives as a structural force to track via benchmarks (AVGO/MRVL), but as a Sterling-Grid buyable it has no constituent — recognition is closing-to-priced and the cohort is mega-cap.
